name: CME Associates (now Artheon)
what_they_do: Civil, environmental, geotechnical, structural and traffic engineering, surveying, planning and construction management for public agencies, municipalities and private developers. Rebranded as Artheon in 2026 when CME, Churchill, Naik and Laberge were combined under Trilon Group; the East Brunswick office is described on the contact page as the Environmental & Geotechnical Division.
customers: Public agencies and municipalities (East Brunswick Township lists CME as township engineer), private developers and institutional clients

size_signals.signal: Seven offices listed with separate phone numbers: Neptune, Camden, East Brunswick, Barnegat, NYC, Cape May Court House, Berlin
Company timeline 1964-2026 (Laberge 1964, Churchill 1976, CME 1983, Naik 1997; Trilon acquisition of CME 2022; merged into Artheon 2026)
Named township engineer in East Brunswick council agenda
Careers page and hiring call-outs on the home page

listing.platform: Google Maps (still listed under the old name CME Associates)
listing.reviews: count not shown in Google's limited view

website_review.primary_cta: No client-facing CTA in the header — the only prominent button is "Careers"; main actions are buried in the footer
website_review.trust_signals: Project case studies with photos (Carteret waterfront, water tank, DOT lab), markets-sectors pages, awards/resource sections, 720-staff history timeline, Trilon Group backing
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Contact page is half-built: no contact form, no email, no street addresses, and sidebars still show "Lorem ipsum" placeholder posts and spammy placeholder comments; /market-sectors/ returns a 404; page titles carry a stray emoji prefix ("🐴 Home - Artheon")
website_review.search_basics: Home title and description are brand/vague ("Built on Legacy, Driven by Purpose") with no engineering terms or town; individual service pages exist with their own URLs and clean headings (e.g. Civil and Traffic Engineering) but no meta description on the one tested
top_issues: No contact form, quote request or email anywhere on the site — phone is the only route
Contact page still has lorem-ipsum placeholder content and spam comments, which undercuts credibility with 720 staff and public-sector work
Brand transition leaves two identities online: Google listing says CME Associates, site says Artheon, old domain redirects
No office addresses or hours published in text; schema is Organization-only
Google rating 3.9 with no visible review-generation process

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google Business Profile exists but still under the pre-rebrand name CME Associates with category "Engineering consultant" and 3.9 rating; hours shown only as "Closed · Opens 9 AM"; the site's robots.txt (Cloudflare content signals) allows Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot but disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot and most AI training crawlers. Answerable: JSON-LD present but only WebPage/Organization with logo — no LocalBusiness, address, telephone, hours or service areas; offices are listed as city + phone only, no street addresses anywhere on the site. Bookable: no form, no email, no booking link; a customer's agent could only dial the number.

operations_signals.signal: Seven offices each with their own phone number, so inbound calls have to be routed by hand
Public-sector work (township engineer appointments, bid documents in council agendas) implies RFP/proposal and document-heavy admin
Careers page and "Join Our Team" messaging suggest hiring volume and onboarding load

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the broken contact page with a working intake: named contact/quote form routed to the right office, published email, office addresses and hours, plus LocalBusiness schema for all seven locations
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page has zero forms/emails/street addresses and shows lorem-ipsum blog placeholders; JSON-LD is Organization-only

top_opportunities.opportunity: Clean up the CME-to-Artheon entity switch: rename and re-verify the Google profile, point it at the new domain, add services/photos/hours, and make page titles and descriptions name engineering services and the towns served
top_opportunities.evidence: Google still shows "CME Associates, Engineering consultant, cmeusa1.com, 3.9"; home title/meta are brand slogans with no service or place

top_opportunities.opportunity: Simple review-request workflow after project milestones to lift the 3.9 rating and give AI answers real service + location detail
top_opportunities.evidence: 3.9 rating on the Google profile with no visible review prompts on the site

scores.reasons: Gap: large firm whose only conversion path is a phone number and whose contact page is unfinished placeholder content. Pay: 720 staff, multi-office, private-equity-backed, public-sector contracts. Ease: the top fixes are a contact form, schema and a profile cleanup, all deliverable in days. Evidence: everything above was seen directly on the site, its robots.txt, and Google Maps.

wrong_claims.claim: The site's robots.txt (Cloudflare content signals) disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot and most AI training crawlers while allowing Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot
wrong_claims.what_is_true: artheon.com/robots.txt is a plain Yoast block: 'User-agent: *' with an empty Disallow, plus one sitemap line. Every crawler, including GPTBot and ClaudeBot, is allowed - there is no Cloudflare content-signals policy.

wrong_claims.claim: Page titles carry a stray emoji prefix ('🐴 Home - Artheon')
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The emoji comes from the browser tab session, not the site; the real title is 'Home - Artheon', with a vague slogan meta description ('transformative infrastructure solutions...').
